files.description: Full-page screenshot of the CorrecTek Cost Disclosure & Transparency page, which contains all certification criteria listings including the single-sentence b(10) EHI Export description.
Screenshot of the §170.315(b)(10) certification criteria label in the table.

Screenshot of the truncated EHI export footnote text: '*EHI can be exported in PDF or C-CDA format. Records for a patient are exported to one or more PDF/C-CDA files. The files created by the export are saved to a folder specified by the us' (truncated on live page; complete text ends '...the user.' per Wayback Machine).

Extracted full text content of the cost disclosure page including the complete b(10) EHI Export description (with the truncation noted and the complete text confirmed via Wayback Machine). This is the entirety of CorrecTek's EHI export documentation.
FHIR R4 endpoints JSON linked from the disclosure page. Contains an empty FHIR Bundle with no endpoint entries. This is for the g(10) API, not the b(10) EHI export.
